title: Mall dream
content: When I have the Mall dream it looks like a mall with huge hallways, but each room is different. Some rooms are hospital rooms, some rooms, some rooms are stores, some rooms are classrooms. There are alien teachers there and alien staff members, nurses ect. They look human but their vibe is very strange and strong and they talk telepathically very strongly. (I have multiple dream stories about them, I'll explain if wanted). In these dreams I am always sneaking around or trying to escape. Sometimes with a group of people. In one dream I went to this basement level. Followed this long hallway, went to this stone elevator with glass walls around it. The elevator went all the way up to the roof of the building. (The roof opened up at the top as the elevator approached it. Once I got to the roof, I discovered I was standing on this stone elevator in the middle of the ocean, that there was no way to escape. Then the elevator went crashing down and it felt so real like I was about to go bye bye. As soon as the elevator hit the bottom the alien staff members were starting at me then I woke up. I have had a lot of dreams about this place and multiple crazy stories.
